data.title: Speeding fine – €98.50, 1 point
data.summary: The Berlin police fines office (Bußgeldstelle) issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) dated 8 December 2025 for speeding 23 km/h over the limit on 12 November 2025. The total is €98.50 and 1 point is entered in the driver register. It was formally delivered on 11 December 2025.
data.explanation: You are accused of driving 93 km/h where 70 km/h was allowed. You can either accept the fine or file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record at the fines office. The app shows the objection deadline. If you file no objection, the notice becomes final and the €98.50 is due two weeks after that. In court proceedings the court is not bound by the fine amount, so it could be higher. Consider getting advice before objecting.

items.title: File objection (Einspruch) against fine notice
items.action: If you disagree, file an objection in writing or on record with the fines office.
items.consequence: Without an objection the notice becomes final (rechtskräftig).
items.quote: Er muss binnen zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Polizei Berlin (Muster) – Bußgeldstelle eingelegt werden.

date.text: binnen zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung

items.title: Pay fine of €98.50
items.action: Transfer €98.50 to the fines office, quoting the file number OWi 5114/25-VK.
items.consequence: Payment is due two weeks after the notice becomes final.
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, fällig; geben Sie bei der Überweisung bitte das Aktenzeichen an.
